articles.summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. ("Peoples") (Nasdaq: PEBO) today announced results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2022. Peoples reported net income of $24.9 million for the second quarter of 2022, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.88. In comparison, Peoples recognized earnings per diluted common share of $0.84 for the first quarter of 2022, and earnings per diluted common share of $0.51 for the second quarter of 2021.
